concept: DAX: microsecond reads of hot keys on top of DynamoDB
tests: Which combination gives millisecond key-value access at scale and microsecond reads of hot items.
expected: DynamoDB (single-digit ms) + DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) — in-memory cache, microseconds for hot items. Triggers: "key-value", "single-digit millisecond", "microsecond reads for hot items".
why_not: RDS read replicas — relational and slower for this pattern; Redshift — analytics; S3 + CloudFront — object delivery, not a key-value DB.
